LanguageData.UMW_ExcludeWoodStuff: Exclude wood from generated unique weapons
LanguageData.UMW_ExcludeWoodStuffDesc: Unique weapons only enter the game through generated rewards (quests, ancient crates, item stashes), rolled from a random eligible material. With this on, wooden materials are dropped from that roll, so a hard-won reward never lands as a wooden longsword. Turn off to allow wooden uniques.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeCooldownDesc: How long a piledriver weapon must rest between earthshakes. The default matches the cooldown on Odyssey's own weapon-trait abilities. Set to 0 for no cooldown at all.
LanguageData.UMW_EarthshakeRadiusDesc: How far the stunning shockwave reaches. It travels through the ground, so walls do not stop it, but it cannot cross a gap with no floor. The overhead ripple scales to match. Remember the shock is indiscriminate: a wider radius catches more of your own colonists too.
LanguageData.UMW_WarbandQuestWeightDesc: Selection weight of the warband quest against the other opportunity-site quests (ancient mercenaries, bandit camps, item stashes...) offered by traders, beggars and reading. Higher = offered more often. 0 disables the quest entirely.
